quarterly_data.quarter: Trane Technologies press release: Trane Technologies Demonstrates Industry-First 800-Volt (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Demonstration, not a product launch or shipment: Trane Technologies announced a successful laboratory proof-of-concept of what it calls the industry's first 800-volt direct current (800 V DC) cooling architecture - working with Eaton and Danfoss, it modified an existing high-efficiency chiller to run on an 800 V DC feed and validated the potential for up to 2% higher system efficiency than AC counterparts while delivering over 1,000 tons (3.5 MW) of cooling capacity. The company says that in a typical 200 MW data center this efficiency gain could unlock up to 1.8 MW of additional compute capacity, and that the demonstration paves the way for fully DC-powered mechanical cooling. CTO Mauro J. Atalla: the demonstration 'marks an important step forward in rethinking how cooling infrastructure can integrate with emerging DC power architectures'.
quarterly_data.figure: over 1,000 tons (3.5 MW) of cooling capacity; up to 2% efficiency improvement; up to 1.8 MW additional compute in a typical 200 MW data center (company estimate)
